name.en: Fake airport sale of unclaimed luggage for a few dollars

how.en: A Facebook post claims the Philip Goldson International Airport is selling suitcases that travellers never collected, for only a few dollars, often “for charity”, with photos of warehouses full of bags. The link goes to a website that takes your card details. The airport says it does not sell unclaimed luggage.

text.en: A social media post says the airport is selling unclaimed luggage.
Each suitcase costs only a few dollars, with delivery promised in days.
The post links to a website where you pay by card.
You pay by card, no bag arrives, and criminals have your card details.
PGIA CHARITY CLEARANCE ✈️ Unclaimed suitcases must go! Each bag with all contents only BZ$4.21. Delivery anywhere in Belize in 5 days. Limited stock, order now 👉 [link]

en: airport selling unclaimed luggage on facebook
lost suitcases for sale for a few dollars
buy a mystery suitcase from the airport
Suitcases full of goods for only a few dollars.
The offer is only on social media and not on the airport’s own website.
You have to pay by card on an unknown website.
Don’t click the link or pay.
If you entered card details, call your bank to block the card and watch for further charges.

sources.title: Philip Goldson International Airport issues scam warning on social media
